variants.title: Cat
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Bara Kitchen animal character concept sheet.
Input image 1: APPROVED CAPYBARA C1, a style/proportion/wardrobe reference, not a character to include in the output.
Create a new animal species in exactly this family of soft 3D game characters. Preserve the reference's head-to-body ratio, oversized broad rounded head, almost invisible neck, gently rounded compact torso, EXTREMELY SHORT legs, small bare animal feet, short connected arms and fingerless mitten paws. Keep the narrow C1 body rather than a very fat pear shape. Simple glossy dark oval animal eyes with a tiny soft highlight, NO white sclera or realistic human iris. Friendly quiet smile. No separated fingers or visible human thumbs. Species ears/tail may differ; do not elongate the torso or legs.
STYLE: match C1 closely: soft sculpted volumes, smooth broad color patches, warm diffuse rendering and subtle texture, no visible polygon facets or realistic fur strands. Same warm ivory background and soft ground shadows.
LAYOUT: landscape 1536x1024 concept sheet with exactly THREE full-body figures in a clean single row, separated with generous spacing, same floor-to-skull-crown scale and ground line. LEFT: male cosmetic preset chef in front three-quarter view, no accessory. CENTER: female cosmetic preset chef in front three-quarter view, same anatomy and clothes, distinguished only by one tiny muted coral rounded fabric ear clip; no eyelashes, makeup or human hair. RIGHT: customer in SIDE PROFILE facing left, with muzzle projection, body depth and tail clearly visible. No text, labels, borders or props. Keep all ears and tails fully within frame.
WARDROBE: Both chefs use the exact reference outfit: ivory short-sleeve double-breasted jacket, four large cocoa buttons, small short front apron, dark cocoa shorts, no hat, no shoes, bare animal paws and feet. Customer reuses the same body and cocoa shorts, wears a plain ivory short-sleeve shirt under a simple muted-sage sleeveless vest with two cocoa buttons; NO apron and NO chef jacket. No other accessories.
Species should remain the same across all three figures; cosmetic presets have identical proportions. Do not include any capybara in this sheet.
SPECIES DESIGN: A cute peach-orange ginger tabby cat. Broad round feline cheeks, soft rounded triangular upright ears with muted pink interiors, small cocoa triangular cat nose and very short ivory paired muzzle pads, simple curved mouth, just three broad subtle darker ginger forehead stripes and a few on its tail. Warm cream chest/muzzle, darker ginger mitten paws, small cat feet. A smooth moderately thick curved cat tail with a rounded tip, clearly visible in profile. Keep a very large round head like C1; not a pointy fox head. Avoid individual whisker hairs; tiny whisker dots suffice.
